features: The fronts of these are durable 100% cotton linen and high quality vegan faux leather,back side is made by cotton linen
The stitching of the linen and leather is firmly stitched and not easy to break, Tight zigzag overlock stitches can avoid fraying and ripping.Classy invisible zipper closure in the bottom.
2-Pack of Faux Leather and Cotton linen Pillow Cover, size 16x16 inch (Does not include pillow inserts).

A leather pillow adds character to any home decor. This Leather-Cotton split design brings that pop to your sofa or bed. Our vegan faux leather cases have been sanded and buffed to create a uniform surface and this technique makes our leather the strongest and most durable.
These throw pillow cases are easy to care, wipe or hand wash recommended due to the faux leather fabric, machine wash in gentle cycle, tumble dry low.
